card.name: Farm products and their end uses
card.fires_on: Small linking words (as, a, into, for, was, is, and) right after an agricultural or commodity noun such as corn, bagasse, molasses or petroleum products. They come where the text is about to say what the material is used for, sold as, or exported as.

modes.label: Use as fuel or feed
modes.description: Linking word after a crop or by-product, before its use such as fuel, feed or ethanol.
modes.example: costs of harvesting the corn cobs compare to their market value as<< a>> fuel. Harvesting corn cobs

modes.label: Trade and export lists
modes.description: A word inside lists of exports or what happens to a product, such as sold or exported.
modes.example: Agriculture: Grain, sugar beets, sunflower seed, vegetables; beef - Exports: Petroleum and<< petroleum>> products, natural gas, wood and wood

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese words and give no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after a crop or by-product that leads into what it is used or sold for.
